hypothesis: Replace independent with-replacement ancestral proposal draws by seeded stochastic sampling without replacement over complete replayable hypergraph-production paths within each suggestion round. The first path retains the Parent distribution, while each subsequent path is sampled from the same task-local grammar distribution renormalized after removing every complete path already examined in that round, preventing a few concentrated derivations from repeatedly consuming proposal work and exposing lower-mass de novo constructions.
method_thesis: Infer a valence-preserving molecular hypergraph-replacement grammar and context-conditioned production-rule prior from the allowed unlabeled corpus, retaining only reusable rules and counts rather than whole corpus molecules. In each independently restarted objective session, parse the ten fixed scored molecules into grammar derivations and initialize a task-local categorical rule distribution from the corpus prior. Generate every subsequent proposal de novo by ancestrally sampling a complete derivation from the start symbol, applying its productions to obtain a molecular graph, and locally resampling after invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate outcomes until the evaluator-announced batch is full. After each oracle response, select the highest-ranked evaluated derivations and perform the defining cross-entropy update: maximum-likelihood refit the context-conditioned rule probabilities to that elite set, with fixed smoothing toward the preceding distribution. Thus feedback moves probability mass toward production combinations occurring in the best complete molecules without crossover, mutation, a surrogate, a value function, or a finite candidate library; the sole optimization target is a stronger terminal Top-1 in each of the five independent sessions and hence their equal-weight mean.

method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline grammar and conditional-prior estimation followed by task-local elite maximum-likelihood projection of categorical rule probabilities
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: ancestral sampling of complete de novo graph derivations from an elite-refit probabilistic molecular grammar
method_tags.representation: molecular hypergraph-replacement derivations with corpus-derived context-conditioned production rules

fixed 512-rule vocabulary, compatibility relation, depth contexts, attachment-label contexts, and corpus-estimated categorical prior
deterministic parsing and exact canonical replay of eligible fixed evaluated molecules into complete grammar derivations
fresh seeded task-local categorical rule distribution initialized from the prepared corpus prior

seeded top-down Gumbel sampling over start, continuation, expansion-site, transition-rule, and fragment-port choices under a distribution frozen for each request

local valence, size, completion, sanitization, canonicalization, evaluated, prior-emission, and within-batch novelty checks

activation_observables.measurement: For every suggestion round, retain the ordered record of all complete derivation leaves examined before the batch fills, including the full replayable action path, unique path signature, unperturbed probability under the frozen task-local categorical model, seeded stochastic priority, acceptance or rejection disposition, and cumulative probability mass removed by earlier leaves. Reconstruct every path and priority transition, report the fraction of examined leaves with distinct signatures, the number of unique complete paths exposed per emitted molecule, and the positive mass that the Parent would still assign to already examined paths but the live sampler assigns zero. Parent n-70c90bde0eea independently resamples with replacement and removes zero complete-path probability mass; activation requires exact reconstruction, distinct-signature fraction 1.0 in every nonempty round, zero reselection of a removed path, and positive cumulative removed mass before at least one later leaf is drawn. Canonical and scaffold counts may diagnose whether sequence coverage survives derivation aliasing but are not substitute activation criteria.

applicability_conditions: The retained finite-depth grammar must have more than ten positive-probability complete replayable paths after each refit; without-replacement sampling cannot create support that the grammar or categorical model has eliminated.

A material share of the Parent's evaluated-molecule collisions must come from repeatedly sampling the same complete derivation paths. If many distinct production paths alias to the same evaluated canonical molecule, path-level exclusion may improve sequence coverage without improving canonical proposal yield.

Useful objective chemistry must remain in lower-probability grammar paths suppressed by the concentrated elite distribution. When the dominant elite paths already contain the only useful basin, forced coverage can weaken exploitation.

The lazy stochastic traversal must reach enough valid terminal leaves within the inherited 125000 finite guard and 3600-second task timeout; no corpus lookup, whole-molecule enumeration, extra oracle call, or unbounded fallback is permitted.

The unchanged canonicalization and task-local novelty filters must convert broader derivation coverage into distinct evaluator-safe molecules; derivation aliases and sanitization failures can erase the proposed benefit.

Current evidence is limited to seed 0 and is dominated by the terminal drd2_docking concentration event, while the hoped-for score benefit concerns broader terminal search including the weak median_2 and sitagliptin_mpo outcomes; multi-seed transfer remains unestablished.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if any complete replayable derivation path is examined more than once in a suggestion round, if a previously examined path retains nonzero live conditional probability, if the logged stochastic leaf order cannot be reconstructed from the frozen round distribution and seeded priorities, or if cumulative removed path mass remains zero before subsequent draws. If those wiring checks pass but the number of distinct complete paths exposed per fixed emitted batch does not increase on concentrated rounds because many supposedly different leaves are actually the same replayable path, the claimed coverage mediation is falsified even if the batch eventually fills.
research_intent.implementation_change: Keep the prepared grammar, rule vocabulary and compatibility masks, fixed initial parsing, hard reward-rank elite selection, length-normalized maximum-likelihood counts, 0.42 cross-entropy projection, task-local categorical probabilities, chemistry checks, accepted-feedback matching, canonicalization, evaluated/prior-emission/within-batch rejection, announced batch size, 125000 finite guard, and JSONL protocol unchanged. Change only `suggest`: freeze the current round's categorical distribution and lazily traverse its finite derivation tree with a seeded top-down Gumbel priority construction, where a leaf identity includes the start rule, every continue/stop and transition rule, expansion-site choice, and concrete fragment-port choice needed for exact replay. Yield terminal leaves in probability-respecting without-replacement order; after any complete leaf is examined, remove that exact path for the remainder of the request regardless of whether its canonical product is emitted or rejected, then continue to the next unique leaf until ten unchanged novelty filters pass or the inherited guard is reached. Log the unperturbed path probability, stochastic priority, complete path signature, disposition, and cumulative removed path mass for every examined complete leaf; the diagnostics must not alter live state or make oracle calls.

The first path retains the Parent distribution, while each subsequent path is sampled from the same task-local grammar distribution renormalized after removing every complete path already examined in that round, preventing a few concentrated derivations from repeatedly consuming proposal work and exposing lower-mass de novo constructions.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-70c90bde0eea completes the repaired seed-0 run, but its unchanged independent ancestral sampler is extremely concentrated late in optimization: the terminal drd2_docking request required 114581 draws for ten proposals, of which 114476 reproduced already evaluated molecules and 95 were within-batch collisions. The preceding root n-f32b42226a66 had already required 12391 draws for ten round-28 proposals, with 12378 evaluated-molecule collisions, and its post-refit ROOT mass outside two active elite start rules was only 0.000011009016773423532. This repeated occupation of proposal work by high-probability derivations accompanies weak final Top-1 values of 0.1970368732287556 on median_2 and 0.12576494551369016 on sitagliptin_mpo. The limiting behavior is therefore poor distinct derivation coverage under sampling with replacement, not failure of grammar replay, oracle feedback, canonicalization, or eventual full-batch completion.

applicability_conditions: The confirmed guarantee is request-local and applies to complete derivations that produce an exactly replayable canonical molecule. The exclusion trie is deliberately reset at the start of every suggest call, so the evidence does not claim zero path repetition across different rounds.

All evaluated round models retain enough positive replayable support: every one of 145 requests exposes at least ten distinct complete paths, none reports without_replacement_support_exhausted, and every announced ten-molecule batch fills.

The frozen-model requirement holds in all 145 requests: every coverage event has identical frozen and final distribution digests, and refitting occurs only after accepted oracle feedback. Candidate and Parent also use the same prepared grammar artifact content.

The unchanged novelty and canonicalization path converts the broader path traversal into 1,450 evaluator-safe unique proposals and all five tasks complete 300 calls, but conversion efficiency is task-dependent because many distinct paths alias to evaluated canonical molecules.

The lazy traversal is operationally supported under this stage profile. Candidate task wall times range from 16.114125613006763 to 38.14921180397505 seconds, the hardest request uses 105 total derivation attempts, and all tasks remain far below the 3,600-second timeout and 125,000-attempt guard without extra oracle calls.

Objective benefit is conditional on useful lower-probability chemistry. This replica supports recovery of the two weak Parent objectives median_2 and sitagliptin_mpo, but not uniform benefit: the dominant drd2_docking basin and two other tasks score lower after the altered sampling trajectory.
Applicability beyond batch size 10, seed 0, this finite-depth 512-rule grammar, and removed request mass up to 0.5550572852939187 remains unestablished.

observable_measurements.name: without_replacement_complete_derivation_coverage
observable_measurements.parent_value: Parent n-70c90bde0eea has no without-replacement state or complete rejected-path ledger. Parent source lines 1533-1699 independently sample ROOT, continue/stop, expansion site, transition rule, and concrete port on every attempt; lines 1701-1733 restart that ancestral sampler after evaluated, prior-emission, or within-batch rejection without retaining an examined path. Therefore the Parent removes exactly zero complete-path probability mass, and a previously examined positive-probability path retains its original positive live probability throughout the frozen suggestion request. Because Parent logs retain full traces only for emitted molecules, their rejected-leaf distinct-signature fraction and unique complete paths per emitted molecule cannot be recovered. Its concentration telemetry nevertheless records 136,882 complete valid attempts for 1,450 emissions across seed 0. In particular, terminal drd2_docking log line 175 records 114,581 complete valid draws for ten emissions, including 114,476 already-evaluated outcomes and 95 within-batch collisions, with no mechanism that sets any examined path's live mass to zero. Relative to this exact zero-removal, with-replacement baseline, the Candidate's positive removal, zero reselection, and reproducible unique-path traversal are an increase in the registered intermediate behavior.
observable_measurements.value: The formal seed-0 Candidate contains all 145 expected suggestion rounds, 29 for each of the five tasks, and every round has one without_replacement_complete_derivation_coverage record at task-log lines 8, 15, ..., 204. These records cover 4,196 complete replayable canonical derivation leaves and 62,472 top-down priority transitions. Within every request, the full serialized action paths as well as their 20-hex signatures are distinct: distinct-signature fraction is 1.0 in 145/145 nonempty rounds, path_reselection_count is 0 in 145/145, and direct comparison of the complete action-path arrays finds zero repeated paths. Every first complete leaf has zero removed mass at every transition and its selected conditional probabilities equal the frozen model probabilities, preserving the Parent distribution for the first leaf. Every one of the 4,051 later leaves is drawn with positive removed mass at the root, and 3,634 later leaves enter at least one selected branch containing previously removed descendant mass, so exclusion changes live conditional sampling rather than only bookkeeping. After each leaf, the logged live reselection probability is zero; the before/after removed-mass chain exactly adds that leaf's positive unperturbed probability and agrees with the event total. Cumulative removed mass is positive in every round and ranges by task from 0.000033074317812247665 to 0.018427485309904016 on deco_hop, 0.00000116760626706195 to 0.22625632773587018 on drd2_docking, 0.00037445175716112344 to 0.2509829742385632 on median_2, 0.014880712835290714 to 0.5091745004066451 on sitagliptin_mpo, and 0.01610729533134208 to 0.5550572852939187 on zaleplon_mpo. Unique complete paths exposed per emitted molecule range from 1.0 to 5.4, 1.0 to 1.3, 1.0 to 3.9, 1.0 to 9.4, and 1.0 to 10.3 respectively; aggregate task values are 812/290 = 2.8, 310/290 = 1.0689655172413792, 621/290 = 2.1413793103448278, 1,207/290 = 4.162068965517242, and 1,246/290 = 4.296551724137931. Independent reconstruction of every record reproduced each path signature, selected token and choice index, prefix/base/removed/remaining mass identity, conditional probability, Gumbel maximum and margin, product and log path probability, cumulative removal chain, and summed stochastic priority with zero discrepancies. A clean replay from the frozen prepared artifact, seed 0, and recorded oracle feedback regenerated the exact proposal order and the exact complete coverage-event digest for all 145/145 rounds. All frozen/final distribution digests agree, all 4,196 leaves replay to their logged canonical product, all 145 batches fill, and there are zero priority-reconstruction errors or support-exhaustion events. The terminal drd2_docking request illustrates the predicted concentrated-regime mediation: the Candidate examines 12 distinct complete paths to emit ten molecules, removes 0.00017290264399087927 model mass, and finishes in 12 attempts, while its own paths remain fully distinct. Canonical aliasing is separately visible and does not substitute for activation: the 4,196 unique within-request paths comprise 1,450 emissions, 2,714 already-evaluated dispositions, and 32 within-batch dispositions, with 676 same-round excess canonical aliases despite zero repeated full paths.

possible_failure_causes: Path exclusion does not imply canonical-molecule novelty. Although no complete replayable path repeats within a request, 676 same-round path aliases collapse onto an already seen canonical product; Candidate records 2,714 already-evaluated and 32 within-batch dispositions. This explains why the Candidate needs more complete valid leaves than the Parent on deco_hop, median_2, sitagliptin_mpo, and zaleplon_mpo even while exact-path coverage is broader.

The trie guarantee begins only after a derivation becomes a replayable canonical leaf. Candidate lines 2061-2069 return incomplete or sanitization-failed constructions before insertion at lines 2140-2144. The replica records 116 sanitization failures, six on median_2, 91 on sitagliptin_mpo, and 19 on zaleplon_mpo, plus nine incomplete or rule/valence failures; those failed action paths are not removed and can still consume repeated proposal work.

Confirmed coverage did not produce the registered positive mean score effect on this replica. The trusted seed-0 macro is 0.463133143130625 versus Parent 0.46644060333759, a paired difference of -0.003307460206965. Candidate Top-1 improves on median_2 by 0.03061371106883698 and sitagliptin_mpo by 0.11075097010947016, but decreases on zaleplon_mpo by 0.03835731383982588, deco_hop by 0.0144206183835934, and drd2_docking by 0.1051240499897142. Forced sequence coverage can therefore weaken exploitation even when its intermediate mechanism is exact.

The observed exclusion totals never exceed 0.5550572852939187 in one request and no support-exhaustion event occurs. This replica does not test numerical behavior when removed mass approaches one, when fewer than ten replayable positive-mass leaves remain, or when the 125,000-attempt guard is reached.

Evidence is limited to seed 0. It establishes deterministic activation for these five 29-round task trajectories, but not cross-seed stability of the path ordering, canonical-yield mediation, runtime, or terminal objective effect.
